_meta.description: Frozen EM-1a research contract; not a production scanner configuration

checkpoint_acceptance.accepted_ist_semantics: accepted_ist means the checkpoint has sufficient trustworthy historical evidence (admitted intraday session, cohort membership, quote/data hygiene, corporate-action boundary validity) to participate in subsequent EMR research. It does NOT mean: predictive value, statistical significance, calibration, production-scanner fitness, equal model weight, EM-4 evidence gate passage, or any influence on canonical ATHENA decisions.
checkpoint_acceptance.why_all_nine: All nine candidates showed identical admitted-symbol-day support (356,225 for TOUCH/CLOSE, 358,177 for OPEN_TO_HIGH) because the relevant EM-1r5 gates -- admitted intraday session, cohort membership, quote/data hygiene, corporate-action boundary validity -- are all session-level facts under today's evidence, not checkpoint-time-level facts. No evidence-quality dimension differentiates one candidate from another at this milestone; predictive differentiation among checkpoints (e.g. P(TOUCH_10 | 09:20) vs P(TOUCH_10 | 14:00)) is a separate, later research question for EM-1c onward, not decided here.

partition_contract.semantics: Strictly chronological, contiguous, non-overlapping, whole-session assignment, backed by real measured eligible-observation and positive-event distributions across the frozen study window (artifacts/research/em1b/partition_measurement.json). Frozen unless changed later through an explicit Owner/Chief Architect decision.
partition_contract.final_test_sealing: FINAL_TEST is a protected holdout: its label outcomes may not be used for feature/checkpoint/event-family/threshold/model-class selection, hyperparameter or XPS weight tuning, probability calibration, or operating-threshold/ranking-policy/architecture decisions before the approved final evaluation gate. Dataset-integrity checks (row counts, partition membership, replay verification) may inspect it freely.
partition_contract.eligible_population_note: EM-1b's eligible symbol-day population is slightly smaller than EM-1r5's reported admitted-session counts (355,724/355,724/357,659 vs EM-1r5's 356,225/356,225/358,177 for TOUCH/CLOSE/OPEN_TO_HIGH) because label computation additionally requires a valid PREVIOUS admitted session to supply the TOUCH/CLOSE reference close -- a structural requirement of the label contract, not a readiness-gate exclusion. Every instrument's chronologically first admitted session has no such predecessor and is therefore unconditionally excluded from EM-1b's population (exactly -518, one per instrument, for OPEN_TO_HIGH, which otherwise has zero corporate-action exclusions; -501 for TOUCH/CLOSE since a handful of instruments' first admitted session was already going to be excluded for corporate-action-boundary reasons independent of this rule).

study_scope.reason: EM-1b (2026-08-26/27): the deterministic production label dataset has been generated and the owner-approved chronological TRAIN/VALIDATION/CALIBRATION/FINAL_TEST partitions assigned (see _meta.partition_contract). Research-ready for EM-1c analysis; FINAL_TEST is a sealed holdout per the partition contract's final_test_sealing clause.
